schools.name: Perranporth Surf School
schools.base: On Perranporth Beach below the promenade car park in summer; at Piran Surf in winter
schools.note: Runs taster lessons through to week-long improver courses, plus family, group and private lessons, for ages 7 and up. All kit is included, and lessons go ahead in poor weather as long as it's safe for beginners.

schools.name: Stoked Surf School
schools.base: 7 Beach Road, Perranporth, next to the main beach car park
schools.note: Standard, family, private and large-group lessons seven days a week in season, from first-timers to progressing surfers, using a seven-level progression system called The Loop.

hire.name: Stoked Surf School
hire.base: On Perranporth Beach, next to the main beach car park
hire.note: Hires soft boards, intermediate boards, custom hardboards, bodyboards and 4/3mm wetsuits for kids and adults, plus boots, gloves and hoods. Changing facilities and storage are included.

hire.name: Bathsheba Surf
hire.note: The surf shop in the village also hires boards; see its website for hire terms.

shops.name: Bathsheba Surf
shops.note: Sells surfboards from Lost, Firewire and Thunderbolt alongside softboards, wetsuits for men, women and kids, leashes, fins, board bags, wax and repair kits.

shops.name: Piran Surf
shops.note: A surf shop selling boards, wetsuits and surfing kit, which also runs lessons and hire. Perranporth Surf School uses it as its winter base.

lessonsIntro: Perranporth is a long, open beach with plenty of room, and surf schools work from the village end near the main car park. It suits first-timers as well as more experienced surfers.

text: Perranporth is a big, busy beach that joins Perran Sands at low tide, and the RNLI describes it as good for surfers and bodyboarders. Lessons usually start from the village end, by the promenade car park, where Perranporth Surf School and Stoked are both based. Both teach total beginners, and Perranporth Surf School keeps running lessons in rough weather if conditions are still safe for learners.

RNLI lifeguards cover the beach daily from 3 April to 1 November in 2026, 10am to 6pm, and Visit Cornwall notes there are toilets right by the promenade car park. Rip currents are the main hazard: in July 2025 lifeguards rescued around 10 swimmers from a flash rip inside the flagged area on a calm day. University of Plymouth research on this beach notes rips are generally more active around low tide, when the sandbars are exposed to breaking waves.

cards.label: Level
cards.title: First-timers to improvers
cards.text: Plenty of whitewater and space; schools teach complete beginners through to week-long improver courses.

cards.label: Best time
cards.title: April to October, lifeguarded hours
cards.text: Lifeguards patrol daily from early April to the start of November, 10am to 6pm.

cards.label: Watch out for
cards.title: Flash rips
cards.text: Rips can open suddenly even in small surf, and are generally more active around low tide.

hireIntro: You can hire boards and wetsuits right on the beach next to the main car park, and from the surf shop in the village.

text: Start on a soft board; Stoked hires softboards for beginners and intermediate boards for progressing surfers, plus custom hardboards once you're ready. Sea temperatures here range from about 9-10C in early March to 15-18C in August, so a 4/3mm full suit with boots covers most of the summer, and you'll want a 5mm suit, gloves and a hood in winter.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: Softboard, then intermediate
cards.text: Beginner softboards for lessons; Softech or similar intermediate boards as you progress.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 4/3 in summer, 5mm in winter
cards.text: A 4/3mm or 3/2mm with boots in summer; a 5/4mm or 5/3mm with gloves, boots and a hood around March.

cards.label: Other craft
cards.title: Great for bodyboarding
cards.text: The RNLI rates Perranporth for bodyboarding; hire a bodyboard on the beach and stay between the red and yellow flags.

shopsIntro: Perranporth has its own surf shops in the village, a few minutes' walk from the beach.
shopsText: Bathsheba Surf on St Pirans Road is the main surf shop in the village, with surfboards from several big brands, softboards, wetsuits for all ages and plenty of hardware such as leashes, fins and board bags. Piran Surf also sells boards and wetsuits. For anything bigger, Newquay's surf shops are about nine miles up the coast.

lessons.q: Is Perranporth good for learning to surf?
lessons.a: Yes. It's a big beach with lots of whitewater for beginners, and two surf schools teach right by the main car park at the village end.

lessons.q: How old do children need to be for lessons at Perranporth?
lessons.a: Perranporth Surf School takes children from age 7. Stoked doesn't publish a minimum age, so ask them directly.

lessons.q: When are lifeguards on Perranporth beach?
lessons.a: In 2026 the RNLI patrols daily from 3 April to 1 November, 10am to 6pm. Dates can change, so check the RNLI website.

hire.q: Where can I hire a surfboard at Perranporth?
hire.a: Stoked Surf School hires boards, bodyboards and wetsuits on the beach next to the main car park, and Bathsheba Surf in the village also does board hire.

hire.q: What thickness wetsuit is hired at Perranporth?
hire.a: Stoked's hire wetsuits are 4/3mm, with boots, gloves and hoods available for colder days.

shops.q: Is there a surf shop in Perranporth?
shops.a: Yes. Bathsheba Surf on St Pirans Road sells boards, wetsuits and accessories, and Piran Surf also sells surf kit.

factCheck.fact: Large busy beach joining Perran Sands at low tide; great for surfers and bodyboarders; lifeguards daily 3 April-1 November 2026, 10am-6pm
Flash rip on 12 July 2025, about 10 swimmers rescued between the red and yellow flags in small surf
West-coast sandbars mean more rip current activity at low tide; research carried out at Perranporth
Perranporth Surf School: summer base on the beach, winter at Piran Surf; promenade car park overlooks base; ages 7+; family, group, private, week courses; kit included; runs in bad weather if safe
Stoked: 7 Beach Road; standard, family, private, large group lessons 7 days a week in season; The Loop seven-level system; mentions Chapel Rock
Stoked hire next to main beach car park: softboards, intermediate boards, custom hardboards, bodyboards, 4/3mm kids and adult wetsuits, boots, gloves, hoods
Bathsheba Surf sells Lost, Firewire, Thunderbolt and softboards, wetsuits, hardware, repair kits; links to surfboard hire
Bathsheba Surf is at 19 St Pirans Rd, Perranporth TR6 0BH and rents boards
Piran Surf is a surf shop in Perranporth selling surfboards, wetsuits and equipment, with lessons and hire
Perranporth sea temperature peaks at 15-18C around 10 August and bottoms out at 9-10C around 1 March
Suggested wetsuits: 4/3mm or 3/2mm with 3mm boots in summer; 5/4mm or 5/3mm with gloves and boots in winter; hood if windy
